text:
Sanjay: Heads-up — us-west1 spot evictions spiked to ~25% in the last 10m, mixed-pool latency up on small models.
Mara: Thanks. Anyone see cluster alerts? 
ops-bot: [ALERT] preemptible_evictions > 20% (us-west1) at 1748607170 :rotating_light:
Leni: Seeing fallbacks to CPU nodes; tails are slow. Which routing policy is live for tiers?
Sanjay: Policy = dedicated -> preemptible -> cpu-fallback. Free-tier locked to us-west1 (no region failover).
Zach: There's the issue — free-tier pinning amplifies churn impact.
Mara: Can we do quick cross-region probes (30s) before failing over? If us-central or us-east responds healthy, divert.
Leni: Probing adds first-request latency. Maybe async probe and only divert on sustained success (e.g., health for 1m).
Frey: Consider model-variant fallback instead of region hops: degrade to a smaller quantized variant in-region.
Sanjay: Draft policy:
- free: enable local quantized variant fallback (q4_0) then CPU; no region_failover
- paid: allow soft-region-failover with probe_sec=30 and ramp_pct=20
- urgent SLA breach: immediate shift to dedicated
Mara: Example config we sketched:
```
{ "tiers": { "free": {"fallback": ["variant-q4_0","cpu"], "region_failover": false}, "paid": {"fallback":["variant-q4_0","preemptible"], "region_failover": {"probe_sec":30, "ramp_pct":20}} } }
```
Leni: q4_0 increases token-level noise for some prompts — need a quality gate per prompt set.
Zach: Route by prompt fingerprint: sensitive prompts pinned to dedicated/paid lanes, others eligible for variant or region fallback.
Sanjay: Add quality header from eval pipeline. If score < 0.9, disallow variant fallback.
Frey: Ops question: what's the probe cost? Extra egress/warmup. 
Mara: Rough estimate: 30s warm-up ~ $0.001 per 1k small requests; cross-region egress can be significant for big payloads.
Leni: Proposal: per-route config — small prompts can probe, large ones use local variant-only.
Zach: We need a rollback runbook if soft-failover regresses quality. Who owns rollback?
Sanjay: Infra oncall does emergency rollback; eng-platform owns policy rollouts. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 3% within 5m of ramp.
Mara: Can we simulate churn in staging with an eviction simulator job? 
Frey: I'll run eviction-sim in staging at 14:00 PST to validate ramp/probe behavior.
Leni: I'll prepare eval prompts and quality gating rules.
Zach: I'll open the routing PR with a feature flag per region and tie to the rollout plan.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: "eviction-probe-rollout" assigned to Zach, Frey, Leni
Sanjay: ACTIONS: Frey -> staging sim; Zach -> PR + feature flag; Leni -> eval set + quality gate; Mara -> monitor dashboards + rollback hook.
Mara: If churn remains >20% post-ramp, we'll escalate to add capacity in us-west1.
Leni: Please ensure probe_result and variant_applied are logged as headers in traces for debugging.
Sanjay: I'll file infra ticket for new metrics and alert thresholds.
Zach: Will post PR link here when ready. Thanks.
